definitions.explanation: A hollow space or opening in something. Can be natural or man-made.
A missing part or position that needs to be filled.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}に{穴|あな}が{開|あ}いています。
examples.english: There's a hole in the wall.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}の{穴|あな}を{埋|う}める。

notes:
{穴|あな} means hole, both literal and figurative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {穴|あな}が{開|あ}く (a hole opens)
- {穴|あな}を{開|あ}ける (make a hole)
- {穴|あな}を{掘|ほ}る (dig a hole)
- {穴|あな}を{埋|う}める (fill a hole/gap)
- {穴|あな}{場|ば} (hidden gem, little-known spot)

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {記憶|きおく}の{穴|あな} (gap in memory)
- スケジュールの{穴|あな} (gap in schedule)
